tools.name: list_machine_services
tools.description: List GovOmniAI machine services and legal sellers. This is discovery only and does not create an order or payment.

tools.name: assess_autonomous_transaction_risk_free
tools.description: Free: assess a proposed autonomous transaction before money moves. Returns risk tier, missing assurance evidence, prioritized controls, and whether a human gate is warranted. Creates no order and requests no payment.

tools.name: qualify_federal_opportunity_free
tools.description: Free: determine whether a public U.S. federal opportunity appears worth deeper pursuit using buyer-provided non-sensitive company facts. Returns fit, eligibility mismatches, capability overlap, teaming indicators, evidence gaps, and next actions. Creates no order or payment.

tools.name: create_agent_offer_verification_order_3usd
tools.description: Create an unpaid $3 GovOmniAI order to verify the structure and integrity of an agent/service offer before relying on it. The result is sealed at order creation. This tool does not charge the buyer; it returns the MPP payment endpoint, order token, terms, and status URL so an authorized buyer agent

tools.name: create_federal_opportunity_qualification_order_5usd
